headline.text: orders on time when suppliers write their dates vaguely (“next week”, “2-3 days late”): a plain date parser vs Sentinel, which plans for the latest reading and asks the supplier after a planner approves (p = 0.050; with exact dates it is 96.7%). The price: until the supplier answers, Sentinel's planned date is often later than the real one. On 150 test messages written blind by a separate AI agent, the first run got 135 fully right.
